messages:
alex_g: FYI — Acme's security team sent a CAIQ follow-up. They want clarification on two things: 1) if we allow customer fine‑tuning with their data, what controls apply (data residency, encryption, model weights storage), and 2) shared responsibility when customer brings their own KMS. Can @sam_security take a look?

maria_sales: Pinged Acme for scope and POC timeline. They said PII will be used in the POC and want evidence of encryption in transit/rest + a statement that model artifacts won't leave the EU region. :eyes: They also asked about deletion policy for trained artifacts.

sam_security: Quick answer summary: we encrypt in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest by default; for Private/Dedicated deployments we can integrate customer‑managed KMS and region‑pin model storage. I'll draft a CAIQ control mapping + shared responsibility table. Question: is the POC Hosted or Dedicated/Private? That changes the ownership rows.

julie_eng: Hosted vs Dedicated differences: Hosted = Redwood-managed infra, model weights in our buckets (Redwood KMS), no customer KMS support for fine‑tuning today. Dedicated/Private = customer can provide KMS, buckets, and region pinning; fine‑tuning allowed on Dedicated/Private only.

alex_g: Acme said they prefer hosted for simplicity but will only accept if we can guarantee EU residency for model weights and SOC2 evidence for key handling. If we can't, they want Dedicated POC. They need the CAIQ rows filled for "Data Protection" and "Model Management" and SOC2/key handling evidence within 2 weeks. Can we meet that?

sam_security: I can produce the CAIQ mapping draft (including references to CCM controls) by EOD. For SOC2 artifacts we can provide the redacted report and key management summary; actual key material never shared. For Dedicated we can provide an architecture diagram + confirmation that customer CMK is used.

julie_eng: Quick Dedicated POC dataflow (draft):
```text
Client -> VPC Peering -> Dedicated Inference Fleet (GPU nodes)
  - KV cache and ephemeral GPU RAM only (no persistent tokens)
  - Model weights stored in customer S3: s3://acme-poc-models-eu
  - Encryption: SSE-KMS with customer CMK (arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123:key/EXAMPLE)
  - Audit logs: customer CloudTrail + optional forward to Redwood Console (log-only)
Fine-tune job runs on Dedicated nodes; job artifacts written to s3://acme-poc-finetune-eu (customer bucket)
Deletion: delete job artifacts + model checkpoints on customer request or per SLA (see contract)
```

sam_security: That covers most of the Dedicated concerns. For Hosted flow: model weights remain in Redwood buckets encrypted with our KMS, and we cannot guarantee customer CMK. We should mark Hosted as "Redwood KMS; no customer KMS; artifacts in Redwood region X (we can bind region but not customer-managed keys)".

maria_sales: Acme is adamant: "model weights cannot leave the EU". They asked if Hosted can be pinned to EU region with documented evidence. Also they asked about pricing for a 2‑week Dedicated POC (2 GPUs) — need a ballpark to include with the CAIQ reply.

julie_eng: Conservative POC estimate: 2 x A10G equiv, 2 weeks, includes storage and support = ~$18,000 (pro‑rated). I'll prepare a line‑item quote tomorrow with burst policy and logs retention costs.

sam_security: Action plan from security side:
- Prepare CAIQ mapping + shared responsibility table (rows: Key management, Model artifact residency, Fine‑tune data handling, Logging & monitoring, Deletion on termination) — draft by EOD.
- Include contract SLA note: standard enterprise is 30 days for deletion; can we shorten for this deal? Need sales to confirm negotiation range.

maria_sales: Acme legal prefers immediate deletion on termination but will accept 7 days if documented. I'll push for 7 days and confirm whether they can provide KMS ARNs for Dedicated.

alex_g: Good. Please treat this as high priority — POC kickoff in ~2 weeks per customer. Summary of owners: Sam -> CAIQ mapping + shared‑resp (EOD). Julie -> POC pricing & infra diagram (tomorrow). Maria -> confirm deletion SLA (7 days?) and KMS ARNs from customer. I'll loop in Acme. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: CAIQ mapping draft created: https://redwood.internal/documents/caqi-drafts/1767123456 (created by sam_security)

maria_sales: Got the link, thanks. cc @julie_eng for the KMS ARN expectation.

sam_security: Noted — I'll also add a short paragraph for legal on evidence types: SOC2 + KMS key access audit + CloudTrail exports. Will attach in draft.

alex_g: Perfect, please ping me once the shared‑resp table is ready so I can include it in the CAIQ response to Acme.

maria_sales: Will do. Thanks team!
